fact: The Artificial Intelligence Bill, 2026 was published as a Bill for Introduction into the Senate in Kenya Gazette Supplement No. 15 (Senate Bills No. 4) on 19 February 2026, to regulate AI, establish the AI Commissioner and create an offence for harmful synthetic media made without consent.
title: The Artificial Intelligence Bill, 2026
publisher: Kenya Gazette Supplement No. 15 (Senate Bills No. 4), Government Printer
